def get_all_executables():
    from thefuck.shells import shell

    tf_alias = get_alias()
    tf_entry_points = ['thefuck', 'fuck']
    bins = [exe.name.decode('utf8') if six.PY2 else exe.name for path in os.environ.get('PATH', '').split(':') for exe in list(Path(path).iterdir()) if not exe.is_dir() and exe.name not in tf_entry_points]
    aliases = [alias.decode('utf8') if six.PY2 else alias for alias in shell.get_aliases() if alias!= tf_alias]
    return bins + aliases
